screens.name: 01-today
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity mobile app UI concept image for a daily routine and habit scheduling app. This is one screen of a coherent six-screen concept. Portrait composition, a single large flat front-facing mobile screen, fully visible with narrow charcoal rounded device border on a plain light warm-gray background. No tilted perspective, no hands, no extra devices, no watermark. Crisp readable UI at generous scale. Shared design language across all screens: warm ivory background #F8F7F3, forest green #24584A primary actions, pale sage cards, warm amber small highlights, near-black text, simple outline icons, sophisticated minimal rounded cards, generous whitespace, clean modern sans-serif type, realistic consistent spacing. Mobile status bar 9:41. English UI labels, short exact text. Calm polished practical interface, no decorative landscape illustrations. Bottom navigation where appropriate: Today, Schedule, Progress. Show functioning UI controls clearly; avoid promotional text and technical implementation labels.
Screen 1: Today dashboard. Header "Good morning" and large "Today", date "Wednesday, October 14", small circular profile. Horizontal seven-day selector with Wed 14 selected. A sage summary card "Small steps, steady progress" and "3 of 5 completed", simple 60% progress ring. Sections "Morning" and "Evening". Morning cards: "Drink water" with "7:00 AM · 2 glasses" and green completed checkbox; "Morning workout" with "7:30 AM · 20 min" and green completed checkbox; "Read a book" with "8:00 AM · 15 min" and green completed checkbox. Evening cards "Go for a walk" with "6:00 PM · 20 min" and empty checkbox; "Plan tomorrow" with "9:30 PM · 5 min" and empty checkbox. Small pill "Busy day mode". Green circular plus button. Today bottom nav selected.
